purpose: Render and manually inspect every frozen V30 development event without allowing post-signal candles or lifecycle outcomes to become signal-time predictors.

required_future_chart_authorization.gate: The renderer must fail before opening any completed Stage-B artifact unless the registry contains exactly one matching CY-037 asset and authorization and the immutable manifest hash, this review-spec hash, and the completed renderer hash all match. CY-037 manifest upstream_bounded_asset.stage_b_registry_sha256 must bind the historical registry hash recorded under the completed Stage-B result's short registry key; it is not compared with the necessarily newer CY-037 registry file.

inputs.candidate_identity: The Stage-A result must bind the exact candidates and representation SHA-256 values and must show stage_a_gate_passed=true, outcomes_read=false, post_signal_end_row_read=false, and post_2020_row_read=false.
inputs.stage_b_identity: The completed result must have stage=SEPARATELY_AUTHORIZED_FROZEN_DEVELOPMENT_OUTCOME_ATTACHMENT, post_2020_row_read=false, and short-key source_hashes binding parent_spec, stage_b_spec, stage_a_runner, stage_b_runner, cy034_manifest, asset_manifest, historical registry, daily, stage_a_result, representation, and candidates. It must bind the exact future_paths and outcomes hashes and declare the corrected fallback-open-before-same-day-high, limit-evidence, unknown-corporate-action, and immediate-prepublish-rehash contract. Missing files, hashes, flags, or columns fail closed.
inputs.stage_b_schema_basis: Exact V30 Stage-B outcome_base schema. No fallback column aliases, inferred lifecycle values, or renderer-side execution reinterpretation are allowed. The renderer consumes the final frozen lifecycle as recorded and does not encode a fallback-day intraday ordering rule.

chart_contract.window: Exactly 126 global trading sessions before signal through 126 global trading sessions after signal, inclusive; 253 calendar slots per event.
chart_contract.contact_sheet_layout: 5 by 5, at most 25 charts per sheet
complete_coverages: Every event_id appears exactly once in the individual-chart index.
Every event_id appears exactly once across chronological contact sheets.
Every event_id appears exactly once across the mutually exclusive outcome-group contact sheets.
chart_contract.publication: Build under a unique same-parent staging directory, audit all individual files, hashes, sheets, placements, templates, and three exactly-once event_id coverages, then rehash every bound input immediately before atomically renaming to stage_c_charts. Refuse if any input changes or the canonical directory exists initially or appears before publication; remove only the runner-owned staging directory on failure.
marks: frozen +10 percent target beginning at entry
executed exit at its true session and price when exit_rel is within +126

for the exactly four audited completed exits at exit_rel 129, 135, 145, or 244, a right-boundary EXIT OUTSIDE WINDOW annotation containing the true exit date, relative session, exit_reason, and literal 'price not plotted', with no fabricated x/y price point
exact lifecycle status and mutually exclusive outcome bucket

out_of_window_exit_contract.eligibility: Only COMPLETED rows with exit_rel > 126 whose event/symbol/date/cal_idx maps to exactly one current_valid=true, hard_valid=true, finite-positive-OHLC daily row no later than 2020-12-31 may use the boundary annotation.
out_of_window_exit_contract.price_axis_rule: An out-of-window exit_price is retained in the ledger but is never included in the plotted window's y-axis min/max and is never drawn at the +126 boundary.
out_of_window_exit_contract.fail_closed: Any entry outside +1 through +3, any completed exit with a missing/nonpositive relative session, any in-window exit missing from valid chart bars, or any unaudited/invalid out-of-window exit aborts publication.

chart_contract.visual_separation: Blue PRE-SIGNAL region is eligible rule evidence. Orange POST-SIGNAL region, including entry, target, exit, status, and return, is attribution only and is forbidden as an original signal rule input.

outcome_groups.NO_COMPLETED_TRADE: no completed lifecycle under the frozen Stage-B contract

per_chart_review.causal_rule_boundary: Only information completed and available by signal decision_at may populate admissible_signal_time_rule_candidate. immediate_post_signal_attribution and every outcome field are explanatory labels only. post_signal_used_as_rule must remain false.

review_sequence: Review every chronological contact sheet and every occupied cell; do not delete, sample, or skip events.
Review every outcome-group sheet and record recurring pre-signal structures separately for large profit, small profit, ordinary loss, severe loss, and incomplete lifecycles.
For every proposed discriminator, record strong counterexamples from both profitable and losing groups and note any calendar clustering.
Reconcile the per-chart ledger against the renderer coverage manifest before compressing rules.

group_summary_required.profit_groups: Summarize recurring pre-signal structures and explicit losing counterexamples.
group_summary_required.loss_groups: Summarize recurring pre-signal failure structures and explicit profitable counterexamples.
group_summary_required.post_signal_observations: Report separately as attribution; never back-project acceptance, rejection, entry, target, or exit behavior into the original buy rule.

requirements: Each rule is deterministic, auditable, and computable entirely from fields available at or before signal decision_at.
Each rule cites the reviewed event_ids supporting it and the strongest counterexamples.
Rules compress recurring structure; they may not become symbol, date, industry, or outcome-specific exceptions.
No neighboring-threshold, lookback, target, holding-period, Top-N, or calendar grid is permitted.
rule_compression.freeze_before_aggregation: Write the final zero-to-five rules and their exact data semantics to one immutable hash-bound rule file before computing any compressed-strategy aggregate outcome.

one_time_validation.prerequisite: The frozen development rule must first pass the V30 annual development gate exactly as preregistered.
one_time_validation.policy: Open the validation outcomes once under a separately authorized, hash-bound runner. If the rule fails, close it without threshold rescue, variant selection, or a second validation read.

prohibited: using any entry-day or later candle as an original signal-time rule
manual chart deletion, duplicate review, sampling, or skipped cells
outcome-informed thresholds or more than five compressed rules
opening 2021 or 2022-2024 before rule freeze and development-gate passage
rewriting the mother definition, entry, target, horizon, or costs during visual review
